mathematical.repair: vertical augmented ideals establish valuation order
mathematical.old:
\cref{itm:ch49-retr:order}  By
\Cref{prop:ch34-retraction}\,\cref{itm:ch34-retr:ideal},
$\log|\mathfrak a|\le\log|\mathfrak a|\circ r_\cX$ for every coherent
ideal $\mathfrak a$ with zero locus in $\cX_0$; in valuative notation
this says $r_\cX(v)(\mathfrak a)\le v(\mathfrak a)$, which is
\eqref{eq:semivaluation-order} after passing to arbitrary local sections by
\Cref{cor:retraction-ideal-monotone}.
mathematical.new:
\cref{itm:ch49-retr:order}  Let $\mathfrak a$ be a coherent ideal on
$X$.  By \Cref{def:ch34-snc-tc}, $\cX$ dominates the constant model;
let $\mathfrak b$ be the pullback of $\mathfrak a$ to $\cX$.
For every integer $m\ge1$, the ideal
$\mathfrak b+(\varpi^m)$ has zero locus in $\cX_0$.
Applying \Cref{prop:ch34-retraction}\,\cref{itm:ch34-retr:ideal}
and the constant-model ideal identity of
\Cref{thm:ch32-gauss-transfer}\,\cref{itm:ch32-gt:ideals} gives
\[
 \min\{r_\cX(v)(\mathfrak a),m\}
 \le \min\{v(\mathfrak a),m\}.
\]
Both Gauss valuations have $\varpi$-value one.  Letting $m$ increase
gives $r_\cX(v)(\mathfrak a)\le v(\mathfrak a)$, including infinite
ideal values.  Since $\mathfrak a$ was arbitrary, this is
\eqref{eq:semivaluation-order}.

mathematical.old:

retractions to their dual cone complexes.  For $v\in X^{\lin}$, BJ22
Appendix~A produces a net $v_i\in X^{\divis}$ with

\[
 w\longmapsto E^\vee(\delta_w)
     =\sup_{\phi\in\mathcal E^1}(E(\phi)-\phi(w))
\]

the energies converge, and
\Cref{thm:bj-linear-topology-complete}(4) gives strong convergence.
This is \cite[Theorem~11.18]{BJ22}.

corollary also covers singular $X$.
